description: Recorded between a .NET Framework 4.8 WCF client (DuplexChannelFactory or ChannelFactory with NetTcpBinding, SecurityMode.None) and a .NET Framework 4.8 WCF service hosting the contract slice of sample.py, through a TCP relay on the loopback interface. notes.client_log is what the client printed for each result and callback, notes.service_log what the service printed for each call it received. Scenario: a session that runs a worklist while its string table still has room, so type names travel as dictionary references, then one with strings longer than a writer buffer.
